messages:
incidents-bot: Pager — SEV2: SmartRouting detected oscillating regional fallbacks for model 'prod-llama-variant'. Symptom: repeated route flips between eu-west-1 and eu-central-1; elevated 5xx (~7%) for EU traffic and ~300ms spike in tail latency. Auto-fallbacks engaged. Paging oncall: @oncall-ecs

sarah.kim: On it. pulling up routing logs and compat matrix now. can someone flag whether this is model mismatch or infra congestion?

mike.tang: I see a pattern: requests with tool-calling metadata are being routed to 'prod-llama-quant-v2' which reports tool_calling=true in the compatibility matrix, but the model actually throws unsupported-toolcall errors in logs. That triggers fallback to fp16 variant which has slightly different perf and capacity -> rps oscillation.

aj_patel: interesting — so compat matrix is lying? how did that field get set? who updated the matrix last?

chris.ng: Recent batch update to compat matrix on 2555554000 by import-job (model-onboarder) set tool_calling=true for several quantized variants. I see a failing job that didn't run the toolcall smoke test due to a timeout.

hailey: Confirming: error snippet from inference logs (eu-west-1):
```
ERROR inference: model exec error: unsupported operation 'invoke_tool' at step 1
trace_id=tx-7a9f
```

cs-tilly: We just got 3 customer tickets in EU reporting degraded assistant responses and occasional 500s. Triage: medium impact but multiple customers. One enterprise customer says their workflow timed out.

mike.tang: Routing policy behavior: smart-routing tries primary variant, if it returns toolcall-error then triggers fallback to variant that supports toolcall. But because the quant variant incorrectly advertised toolcall support, it accepts some traffic before failing and tripping the fallback. The fallback path goes to another region/variant which then routes back under load -> loop.

oncall-ecs: Initial mitigation suggestion: flip smart-fallback-policy for EU to conservative (disable cross-region fallback) and pin EU routes to fp16 variants until compat matrix is fixed. That should stop oscillation.

chris.ng: I can push a temporary policy patch. Command to patch routing-config (runbook snippet):
```
# pin eu routes and disable cross-region fallback
redwoodctl routing update --scope eu --policy conservative --pin-model prod-llama-fp16-v1
```

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for routing-config patch. CI checks: basic. ETA ~ 45s.

incidents-bot: Change control: emergency routing patch started by chris.ng. Runbook reference: /ops/runbooks/routing-oscillation.md. Notify #customers impacted after mitigation.

hailey: While patching, I'm running a compatibility audit across variants to find mismatched flags (tool_calling, max_context_tokens, kv-cache support). Early diff shows: prod-llama-quant-v2 has tool_calling=true but max_context_tokens=2048; actual binaries appear built with 1024 context (evictions thrown). So two mismatches.

aj_patel: That's the root then — both toolcall and context mismatch. Quant build pipeline didn't propagate metadata. Need blocking fix in onboarding pipeline.

mike.tang: Routing patch is live — traffic pinned to prod-llama-fp16-v1 in eu-west-1. Observability: 5xx rate dropping from 7% -> 0.9% over the last 60s, tail latency normalizing. No further cross-region flips detected.

cs-tilly: Notifying impacted customers now with interim status: "We've pinned EU traffic to a compatible variant to stop oscillations; engineering investigating root cause; we'll follow up with timeline."

chris.ng: Logged rollbackable config: routing-config@2026-06-02T11:12:08Z. Saved snapshot.

ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: run the compatibility-sanity-checker job and mark variants failing in the matrix to 'unsafe' state. Command: `infra-jobs run compat-sanity --models prod-llama-* --notify on`

hailey: I've started the compat-sanity job. Early results: prod-llama-quant-v2: fails toolcall smoke test (exit 1), context mismatch (reported 2048 vs actual 1024), quantization flags differ from onboarding manifest.

aj_patel: Action items: 1) Mark prod-llama-quant-v2 as unsafe in catalog (hailey). 2) Rollforward fix in model-onboarding to include toolcall smoke test and binary metadata verification (chris + aj). 3) Postmortem and customer comms draft (sarah + cs-tilly). 4) Add policy guard to smart-routing to double-check compat flags before any fallback (mike).

mike.tang: I'll add a quick guard to the smart-routing decision path: if target_variant.tool_calling != request.toolcall_required -> do not consider it primary. Quick patch ETA 2 hours but we can push a hotfix to make routing consult a runtime probe first (short-circuit).

incidents-bot: Incident timeline recorded. Sev2 pager acknowledged by oncall-ecs.

oncall-ecs: staying on until handoff. will do a full warm-handoff to next oncall at 2555555600.

cs-tilly: Customer-facing summary (to send after internal review):
- What happened: Smart routing routed some EU traffic to a quantized variant that incorrectly advertised tool-calling and context support. The mismatch caused errors and triggered cross-region fallbacks, producing oscillating routing and increased 5xx.
- Impact: Elevated error rates and latency for EU customers; a handful of enterprise customers reported timeouts.
- Mitigation: We pinned EU traffic to a known-compatible fp16 variant, stopped cross-region fallback, and are marking the problematic variant unsafe.
- Next steps: compatibility fix in onboarding, routing guard, postmortem, outreach and credits if needed.

hailey: I've set prod-llama-quant-v2 state=unsafe in the catalog and added a ticket to the onboarding pipeline: ONBOARD-4723.

chris.ng: I'll coordinate the rollout of the routing-guard patch with mike; we should include a canary in eu-west-1 for 30m.

mike.tang: Agree. Will create a canary flag. Also adding metric alert: if fallback-rate > 2% for 5m trigger page.

sarah.kim: Drafting postmortem. Root cause: incompat metadata + skipped smoke tests in import job. Contributing factor: routing logic trusting static catalog flags without runtime probe.

cs-tilly: Customer comms sent to impacted accounts. One asks for timeline to full fix; we'll offer to follow up after postmortem.

incidents-bot: Incident transitions to "under investigation". Severity downgraded to SEV3 at 2555555580 after mitigation.

oncall-ecs: Handoff: next oncall is @mike.tang at 2555555600. Leaving notes in incident doc: /incidents/2555555555/notes.

chris.ng: Locking down: patch to onboarding pipeline and compat checks assigned to me & aj, ETA 3 days for fix+tests. Postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow.

aj_patel: Will also add an integration test that deploys a tiny tool-call in a sandbox and verifies success before a variant is marked compatible.

hailey: Closing loop: compat-sanity job full output uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-ops/compat-audits/2555555555/results.json

sarah.kim: Thanks team — good quick mitigation. We'll follow up with timeline and postmortem.

cs-tilly: Closing customer thread for now; will re-open if any regression.

incidents-bot: Incident logged with ID IR-2026-0611-01. Timeline and actions captured.
